notes.title: Deitrus Hotfix 1.02
notes.notes:
Deitrus Hotfix 1.02:

New Features/Updates:

[list]
[*] Achievements now available! Show them off to friends and family.
[*] Previous accomplishments, where possible, should award Achievements retroactively.
[/list]

notes.title: Deitrus Hotfix 1.01
notes.notes:
We’ve just pushed Deitrus hotfix 1.01 

New Features/Updates:
[list]
[*] Controller input is more stable in walking and battle control
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Dialogue audio plays at appropriate times
[*] A Bug where, when fighting Zanth0r, the player would not take damage visibly
[*] A visual glitch in the credits for steam deck users
[*] A visual glitch in the final scene for steam deck users
[*] A handful of minor typos
[/list]
